facts.fact: A UNDP Cameroon request for quotations posted on 7 August 2026 seeks equipment for the digitalisation of civil status registration at three pilot centres, deadline 24 August 2026; the centres are not named and no budget is given.
facts.system: digitalisation of civil status registration (three pilot centres)

facts.fact: The tender notice of 7 August 2026 names UNDP Cameroon as contracting authority and UNDP as funding agency for the pilot centres' equipment, budget not stated.
